project.name: bot-pilot-google-calendar-connector-rest
project.description:
Driving adapter: Spring MVC REST controllers.
Contains: - OAuthController — GET /oauth2/start, GET /oauth2/callback - CalendarController — GET /calendar/google/events/busy, POST /calendar/google/events/create
The OAuth flow (start + callback) is an adapter concern: it drives the Google OAuth library to obtain credentials and then calls the application layer to persist them. It is NOT a use case — there is no business logic, only protocol translation between HTTP and the application service.
CalendarController translates HTTP parameters to use-case calls and maps CalendarEventCreationResult (sealed) to HTTP responses using pattern-matching switch, exactly as FaqSearchController does with BotResponse.
